text: A defender's afternoon for you, H. Sørensen: Redmoor FC have 76 percent of the ball over the match. Your job is to keep that back line tight.
D. Moreau scores, 1-0. D. Moreau was 8.3 metres from you when the shot came. You were 1.1 metres ahead of the rest of your line.
This one is on you, H. Sørensen. What if you had stepped up?
You step up, and the goal at 69.5 seconds never comes. It is 0-0, not 1-0.
D. Moreau scores, 2-0. R. Takahashi was 2.1 metres from you when the shot came. You were 17 metres ahead of the rest of your line.
A. Brennan wins that one and takes the ball off you.
You read the pass and step in. Ball won.
